description: This file defines classes, functions, and templates for managing and manipulating Torch JIT modules, including module registration, cloning, serialization, and iteration over module components like parameters, buffers, and submodules.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a Torch JIT module with methods for registration, cloning, serialization, and iteration over its components.

classes.name: detail::SlotCursor
classes.description: Helper struct for iterating over module slots during traversal.

classes.name: slot_iterator_impl
classes.description: Iterator template for traversing module attributes, buffers, parameters, or submodules based on a Policy.

classes.name: slot_list_impl
classes.description: Abstract list of module slots (parameters, buffers, attributes, submodules) with iteration support.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Executes the module's forward method with given inputs.

methods.name: register_buffer
methods.description: Registers a buffer tensor with the module.

methods.name: register_parameter
methods.description: Registers a parameter tensor with the module.

methods.name: register_attribute
methods.description: Registers an attribute with the module.

methods.name: named_parameters
methods.description: Returns all named parameters, optionally recursively.

methods.name: named_buffers
methods.description: Returns all named buffers, optionally recursively.

methods.name: named_attributes
methods.description: Returns all named attributes, optionally recursively.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the module, with options for deep copy and ignoring specific methods/attributes.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the module as a function with given inputs.

methods.name: create_class
methods.description: Creates a class instance from the module.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes the module to a stream or file.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Moves or casts parameters to specified device or dtype.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Sets the module in training mode.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Sets the module in evaluation mode.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of the module.
